interactiveCheckout.title: One checkout, before and after
interactiveCheckout.description: A sample WooCommerce checkout for an adjustable desk lamp. The payment step includes a buyer handoff through the store’s gateway; this example creates no real order.

outcomes.before: The run stops at contact details. Payment and order placement are not reached.
outcomes.after: The sample run reaches order placement after the phone requirement is corrected and the buyer completes payment.

cart.label: Add to cart
cart.before: The sample item enters the cart.
cart.after: The sample item enters the cart.

contact.label: Contact details
contact.before: Checkout asks for a phone number the agent doesn’t have.
contact.after: Phone is optional in this example; required contact details are present.

payment.label: Payment
payment.after: The buyer completes payment through the store’s gateway.

order.label: Order placed
order.before: The blocked run creates no order.
order.after: The sample reaches a WooCommerce order.
